description: This file defines the ReportTo entity class, which models the reporting relationships between employees in the HRM system, including supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method, using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: ReportTo
classes.description: Entity class representing the reporting relationship between an employee's supervisor and subordinate, including reporting method, with ORM mappings.

methods.name: getSupervisor
methods.description: Returns the supervisor Employee entity associated with this report-to relationship.

methods.name: setSupervisor
methods.description: Sets the supervisor Employee entity for this report-to relationship.

methods.name: getSubordinate
methods.description: Returns the subordinate Employee entity associated with this report-to relationship.

methods.name: setSubordinate
methods.description: Sets the subordinate Employee entity for this report-to relationship.

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Returns the reporting method used in this relationship.

methods.name: setReportingMethod
methods.description: Sets the reporting method for this relationship.
